MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The epoxy felt useful because my tape and vinyl cement purchases show an interest in practical repairs, and it offers another way to bond damaged parts.",
    "The assorted heat shrink tubing and sealed wire connectors complement my earlier connector kit by helping insulate or seal electrical repairs."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The washers, screws, and battery lugs require particular sizes and applications that my past purchases do not establish a need for.",
    "Owning a handtruck does not mean I need mounting casters, and nothing in my history indicates a metal cutting task or a compatible cutting tool.",
    "Ten tubes of super glue exceed my current needs, while the red-only heat shrink kit adds little when I would already choose the assorted kit."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair supply purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any hardware, even when usefulness depends on a specific job.",
    "My wire connector purchase seems to have been stretched into a need for specialized heavy battery terminals without evidence that I work with those cable sizes."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I need supplies that complement what I already have; shared repair or electrical wording alone does not make an item useful to me.",
    "Quantity and flexibility matter: an assorted kit offers useful options, but a large adhesive pack or a second, more limited tubing kit is harder to justify."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but often assumed specific projects, sizes, and quantities that my history does not support."
}
